annotations.title: Property DCF from a rent roll

description: Property-level discounted cash flow from an in-place rent roll: each lease's rent, escalations, remaining term, and expense recovery (NNN, gross, base year), then at expiration one blended lease weighted by the renewal probability (renewal vs new-tenant rent, free rent, TI, leasing commissions, and new-tenant downtime, with fractional downtime and free rent kept as part months rather than rounded); market rent growth, general vacancy and credit loss, operating expenses, management fee, and capital reserves. Returns the annual cash-flow table (NOI and cash flow before debt) for the hold plus one year, the exit value at a cap rate on forward (or trailing) NOI less selling costs, the value (PV at the discount rate, end-of-year or mid-year), and with a purchase price the NPV, unlevered IRR, and equity multiple, with every lease event and convention stated. Deterministic: the same inputs always give the same result, with formula ID calc.dcf_pro_forma@2, every step, and any warnings.

capital_reserve_psf_annual.description: Year-1 capital reserve, USD/SF/yr over the building area, below NOI. Grows with expense_growth_rate.

credit_loss_rate.description: Credit loss as a share of gross revenue, on top of general vacancy. Must be less than 1.

discount_rate.description: Annual unlevered discount rate, e.g. 0.08. The present value at this rate is the value. Must be less than 1.

exit_cap_rate.description: Exit (terminal) cap rate applied to the exit NOI, e.g. 0.07. Must be greater than 0. Must be less than 1.

exit_noi_basis.description: "forward": the NOI of the year after the hold (the usual convention); "trailing": the NOI of the final hold year.

expense_growth_rate.description: Annual growth of operating expenses and capital reserves, e.g. 0.03: year y = year 1 × (1 + g)^(y − 1). Must be greater than -1. Must be less than 1.

general_vacancy_rate.description: General vacancy allowance as a share of gross revenue (base rent after free rent, plus recoveries), on top of the downtime modelled at rollover. Must be less than 1.

hold_years.description: Holding period in years. The property is sold at the end of the last year; one more year is projected for the forward NOI.

leases.description: Rent roll: one entry per lease or vacant suite (at most 200). The building area is the sum of their areas.

area_sf.description: Leased area, SF. Must be greater than 0.

base_year_opex_psf_annual.description: Operating expenses in the lease's base year, USD/SF/yr: the tenant pays the excess above it. Required when recovery is base_year.

escalation_rate.description: Annual bump in the in-place rent, e.g. 0.03, applied first in next_escalation_month and every 12 months after. Must be less than 1.

free_rent_months_remaining.description: Months of in-place free base rent still to run from the analysis start (months 1 to this are abated).

leasing.description: Per-lease overrides of market_leasing (any subset of its fields).

downtime_months.description: Months vacant before a new tenant starts paying (no downtime is assumed on renewal). Blended downtime = (1 − renewal_probability) × this, kept fractional, not rounded: the suite is vacant for the whole months and the rollover lease's first month collects 1 − the fraction of its rent and recoveries (0.45 months of downtime: the first month collects 55%).

free_rent_months_new.description: Months of free base rent for a new tenant at the start of its lease.

free_rent_months_renewal.description: Months of free base rent on a renewal. Blended free rent = p × this + (1 − p) × free_rent_months_new, kept fractional: the whole months are fully abated and the next month by the fraction.

lc_rate_new.description: Leasing commission for a new tenant as a share of the base rent payable over the lease term after free rent, e.g. 0.06. Must be less than 1.

lc_rate_renewal.description: Leasing commission on a renewal, same basis, e.g. 0.03. Must be less than 1.

lease_term_months.description: Term of each lease signed at rollover (renewal or new tenant), months.

recovery.description: Expense recovery on rollover leases: "nnn" (tenant pays its share of operating expenses), "gross" (none), or "base_year" (expenses above the lease's first-year level).

renewal_probability.description: Probability the tenant renews at expiration, 0 to 1 (e.g. 0.65). Blends the renewal and new-tenant assumptions below.

renewal_rent_pct_of_market.description: Renewal rent as a share of market rent, e.g. 0.95 for a 5% renewal discount; new tenants pay market rent. Must be greater than 0.

rent_escalation_rate.description: Annual bump in a rollover lease's base rent, compounding every 12 months from its start, e.g. 0.03. Must be less than 1.

ti_psf_new.description: Tenant improvement allowance for a new tenant, USD/SF in today's dollars (grown at market_rent_growth_rate to the lease start).

ti_psf_renewal.description: Tenant improvement allowance on a renewal, USD/SF in today's dollars.

market_rent_psf_annual.description: Market rent for this space today, USD/SF/yr. Grows at market_rent_growth_rate each analysis year.

months_remaining.description: Months left on the lease from the analysis start: the lease runs through this month (1 = expires at the end of month 1). 0 means the space is vacant at the start and is leased to a new tenant after downtime_months.

next_escalation_month.description: Analysis month of the next in-place rent bump (default 13, the start of year 2). Use the lease's anniversary month.

rent_psf_annual.description: Current in-place base rent, USD/SF/yr (0 for space vacant at the start).

management_fee_rate.description: Management fee as a share of effective gross revenue, e.g. 0.03; not recovered. Must be less than 1.

market_leasing.description: Market leasing assumptions applied at every lease expiration (and to space vacant at the start). A lease's own `leasing` object overrides any of them.

downtime_months.description: Months vacant before a new tenant starts paying (no downtime is assumed on renewal). Blended downtime = (1 − renewal_probability) × this, kept fractional, not rounded: the suite is vacant for the whole months and the rollover lease's first month collects 1 − the fraction of its rent and recoveries (0.45 months of downtime: the first month collects 55%).

free_rent_months_new.description: Months of free base rent for a new tenant at the start of its lease.

free_rent_months_renewal.description: Months of free base rent on a renewal. Blended free rent = p × this + (1 − p) × free_rent_months_new, kept fractional: the whole months are fully abated and the next month by the fraction.

lc_rate_new.description: Leasing commission for a new tenant as a share of the base rent payable over the lease term after free rent, e.g. 0.06. Must be less than 1.

lc_rate_renewal.description: Leasing commission on a renewal, same basis, e.g. 0.03. Must be less than 1.

lease_term_months.description: Term of each lease signed at rollover (renewal or new tenant), months.

recovery.description: Expense recovery on rollover leases: "nnn" (tenant pays its share of operating expenses), "gross" (none), or "base_year" (expenses above the lease's first-year level).

renewal_probability.description: Probability the tenant renews at expiration, 0 to 1 (e.g. 0.65). Blends the renewal and new-tenant assumptions below.

renewal_rent_pct_of_market.description: Renewal rent as a share of market rent, e.g. 0.95 for a 5% renewal discount; new tenants pay market rent. Must be greater than 0.

rent_escalation_rate.description: Annual bump in a rollover lease's base rent, compounding every 12 months from its start, e.g. 0.03. Must be less than 1.

ti_psf_new.description: Tenant improvement allowance for a new tenant, USD/SF in today's dollars (grown at market_rent_growth_rate to the lease start).

ti_psf_renewal.description: Tenant improvement allowance on a renewal, USD/SF in today's dollars.

market_rent_growth_rate.description: Annual market rent growth, e.g. 0.03. Market rent and TI in analysis year y = today's × (1 + g)^(y − 1). Must be greater than -1. Must be less than 1.

non_recoverable_expenses_annual.description: Year-1 operating expenses no tenant reimburses, USD/yr.

operating_expenses_psf_annual.description: Year-1 recoverable operating expenses, USD/SF/yr over the whole building area.

purchase_price.description: Price paid at the start, USD. Adds the NPV (value − price), the unlevered IRR and the going-in cap rate on price. Must be greater than 0.

selling_cost_rate.description: Selling costs as a share of the gross sale price, e.g. 0.02. Must be less than 1.

timing.description: "end_of_year": each year's cash flow is discounted (1 + r)^y (Excel NPV). "mid_year": operating cash flows at (1 + r)^(y − 0.5); the sale is always discounted at the end of the hold.
